svg.title: DISCRETA
svg.desc: DISCRETA: a classical cryptography and frequency analysis laboratory. The alphabet shifted by a Caesar key sits above a letter-frequency chart in which the ciphertext distribution is the English reference shifted by the key, with the most frequent letter highlighted. The bars use the published English reference frequencies. Illustrative artwork; nothing in it is live data.
svg.text: Encrypt with Caesar, affine and Vigenère,
then break them with frequencies, χ²,
the index of coincidence and Kasiski.
Illustrative: the English reference, shifted by the key.
